select_devices.title: Choose devices
select_devices.description: {count} devices on your Amazon account can be added to Home Assistant. You can change this later without signing in again.

devices_pick.title: Choose devices
devices_pick.description: Tick each of the {count} devices you want in Home Assistant: one entity per Alexa feature (switch, select, number, sensor, lock), exactly as Alexa reports it. Nothing is assembled here; build fans and other whole devices from these entities in Kitbash. Scene selection follows on a separate screen.

data_description.include_endpoints: One entity per feature, nothing assembled.

login_direct.title: Sign in directly on Amazon
login_direct.description: Choose your Amazon marketplace. On the next screen, open Amazon in a separate browser tab and sign in there. Enter your password and verification code only on Amazon.

direct_redirect.title: Complete Amazon sign-in
direct_redirect.description:
1. [Open Amazon sign-in]({login_url}) in a separate browser tab. Keep this form open.
2. Complete sign-in and any verification Amazon asks for.
3. When you reach a URL containing `/ap/maplanding`, copy the full address-bar URL. A blank or error page there is expected.
4. Paste that URL below and submit promptly.

The account will be checked before the integration uses these credentials. If verification or saving fails, retry without starting another sign-in. Select Start a new sign-in if Amazon rejects the authorization code. Never share the redirect URL.

scenes.title: Scenes
scenes.description: Choose from {count} Alexa scenes. All scenes start unselected. Selected scenes become buttons grouped in one Scenes card. Pressing a button activates that scene. Removing a selection deletes its button.

data_description.include_scenes: One button per scene. Scene selection is separate from devices.

confirm_legacy_account.title: Confirm the account for this older entry
confirm_legacy_account.description: Amazon verified the signed-in account as {account}. This older entry did not record its account identity, and the previous sign-in can no longer verify it. Confirm that this is the account originally used for this entry. Your existing entry, devices and scenes will be kept. Cancel if this is a different account.

data.confirm_account: This is the Amazon account originally used for this entry

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Amazon. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Amazon rejected those credentials. The refresh token may have been revoked.
error.invalid_redirect: Paste the full HTTPS URL from the final /ap/maplanding page on the marketplace you selected, including its authorization code.
error.direct_login_failed: Amazon rejected the sign-in or registration. Select Start a new sign-in and complete Amazon sign-in again.
error.signin_save_failed: Could not save the sign-in. Check Home Assistant storage permissions and retry without starting a new sign-in.
error.account_confirmation_required: Confirm the account to finish recovery, or cancel to keep the existing sign-in.

abort.already_configured: This Amazon account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That sign-in was for a different Amazon account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up for.

init.title: Works with Alexa options
init.description: Add or remove devices and scenes without signing in again. Saved changes reload this integration.

devices.title: Choose devices
devices.description: Choose from {count} devices. Current selections are checked. Click Next to choose scenes. Unchecking a device removes its Home Assistant entities when you save.

data_description.include_endpoints: One entity per feature, nothing assembled.

scenes.title: Scenes
scenes.description: Choose from {count} Alexa scenes. Current selections are checked. Selected scenes appear as buttons under Scenes. Unchecking a scene removes its button. Submit saves your device and scene selections.

data_description.include_scenes: One button per scene. Scene selection is separate from devices.

polling.title: Polling interval
polling.description: Choose how often device state and scene discovery are refreshed.

error.entry_unavailable: The integration inventory is unavailable. Load or reload the integration, then try again. Your saved selections are kept.

abort.reauth_started: Open the Works with Alexa reauthentication form to sign in on Amazon.
